title: Sixth Word Conclusion Ease Of The Sale Lawful Bounds And Servanthood

questions.question: In this part, what is being asked about first?
questions.answer: Whether giving back Allah’s trust is really hard.

questions.question: How is that question answered?
questions.answer: It says it is not hard at all.

questions.question: Why is it said to be not too hard for people?
questions.answer: Because the allowed things are wide and enough for people.

questions.question: What does the passage say about doing what Allah forbids?
questions.answer: There is no need to go into it.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Allah’s commands?
questions.answer: They are easy and not many.

questions.question: What kind of honor is serving Allah?
questions.answer: A very joyful and special honor.

questions.question: What are a person’s duties compared to in the passage?
questions.answer: The duties are compared to what a soldier does.

questions.question: How should a person begin actions?
questions.answer: In Allah’s name.

questions.question: How should a person take and give things?
questions.answer: For Allah’s sake.

questions.question: How should a person act or stop acting?
questions.answer: By following Allah’s permission and law.

questions.question: What should a person do after making mistakes?
questions.answer: Ask Allah to forgive him.

questions.question: What does the prayer ask Allah to help us be?
questions.answer: Careful keepers of His trust until it is taken back.

questions.question: What big idea does this passage teach about Allah’s trust?
questions.answer: Keeping it the right way is easy, not too heavy.

questions.question: What makes the right path easier than people may think?
questions.answer: There are many lawful choices, so people do not need sinful ones.

questions.question: Are the things Allah requires described as heavy and many, or light and few?
questions.answer: Light and few.

questions.question: What good feeling comes from being Allah’s servant and soldier?
questions.answer: Deep joy and honor.

questions.question: In the soldier example, what does that teach about a believer’s life?
questions.answer: A believer should obey Allah in daily actions.

questions.question: What simple rule is given for what we do every day?
questions.answer: Do things in Allah’s name.

questions.question: What rule is given for receiving and giving?
questions.answer: Do both for Allah.

questions.question: What rule is given for moving and stopping?
questions.answer: Follow Allah’s permission and His law.

questions.question: In the prayer, what is asked besides forgiveness?
questions.answer: To be accepted as Allah’s servants.

questions.question: What does the ending of the prayer show about the trust?
questions.answer: It belongs to Allah and will return to Him when He wills.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the size of what is halal, or allowed?
questions.answer: It is broad and enough for people.

questions.question: What does that teach us about haram, or forbidden things?
questions.answer: People do not need them.

questions.question: Why might some people stay away from this good trade, according to the opening questions?
questions.answer: They may think it is too hard or too heavy.

questions.question: What is the true answer to that worry?
questions.answer: It is not truly heavy.

questions.question: What two words describe Allah’s duties in the passage?
questions.answer: Light and few.

questions.question: What picture is used to show how a person should live?
questions.answer: A soldier serving his leader.

questions.question: What should come first when starting a deed?
questions.answer: Remembering Allah and acting for Him.

questions.question: How should choices about giving and receiving be made?
questions.answer: They should be done for Allah.

questions.question: What should guide a person’s actions and pauses?
questions.answer: Allah’s permission and rules.

questions.question: What should happen after a shortcoming?
questions.answer: The person should turn back to Allah.

questions.question: What does the prayer ask Allah to do with our mistakes?
questions.answer: Pardon them.

questions.question: What future help is asked for at the end of the prayer?
questions.answer: To keep the trust safely until Allah takes it back.

questions.question: Does the passage present serving Allah as miserable or as full of honor?
questions.answer: As full of honor.

questions.question: What feeling is added to that honor?
questions.answer: Great pleasure.

questions.question: What is one reason this service is not too hard?
questions.answer: Allah made many allowed things for people.

questions.question: What does the passage say about crossing the limits?
questions.answer: It is unnecessary.

questions.question: If Allah’s duties are light and few, what does that tell us about obeying Him?
questions.answer: It is doable for people.

questions.question: The passage says to be like a soldier. What does that mean in a simple way?
questions.answer: It means to obey Allah carefully.

questions.question: What should a Muslim remember before acting?
questions.answer: To do it in Allah’s name.

questions.question: How should a Muslim handle what he gets and what he gives away?
questions.answer: In a way that pleases Allah.

questions.question: What should decide when a person goes forward or stops?
questions.answer: Allah’s command and permission.

questions.question: What should someone do if he fails to do all this well?
questions.answer: Ask Allah to forgive him.

questions.question: In the du‘a, what relationship with Allah do we ask to have?
questions.answer: We ask to be His servants.

questions.question: Why does the prayer ask for help in guarding the trust?
questions.answer: So we stay faithful until the trust returns to Allah.

questions.question: What wrong idea about this trade is challenged at the start?
questions.answer: The idea that it is too difficult.

questions.question: What clear reply is given to that wrong idea?
questions.answer: It is not difficult at all.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about lawful enjoyments?
questions.answer: They are plenty and enough.

questions.question: What can we infer about forbidden things from that teaching?
questions.answer: They are not needed.

questions.question: How many duties does the passage say Allah has placed on people: many or few?
questions.answer: Few.

questions.question: How are those duties described: heavy or light?
questions.answer: Light.

questions.question: What beautiful title is given to a believer besides servant?
questions.answer: A soldier of Allah.

questions.question: What is the believer’s basic job in daily life?
questions.answer: To act for Allah in what he does.

questions.question: What three parts of life are mentioned for obeying Allah?
questions.answer: Starting deeds, taking and giving, and moving or stopping.

questions.question: When a person slips, what is the next right step?
questions.answer: To seek forgiveness.

questions.question: What does the prayer ask Allah to accept us as?
questions.answer: His servants.

questions.question: What trust-related prayer is made at the end?
questions.answer: That we protect Allah’s trust well until He takes it back.

questions.question: What is the passage trying to make people stop thinking?
questions.answer: That obeying Allah with His trust is too burdensome.

questions.question: What reason is given from everyday life to show it is not burdensome?
questions.answer: The allowed ways are wide enough for human wants.

questions.question: According to the passage, must people go into forbidden things?
questions.answer: No, they do not need to.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the amount of Allah’s commands?
questions.answer: There are not many.

questions.question: What does it say about the weight of those commands?
questions.answer: They are easy to carry.

questions.question: What two noble roles are joined together for a believer?
questions.answer: Servant and soldier of Allah.

questions.question: What makes those roles special?
questions.answer: They bring honor and joy.

questions.question: What pattern should a believer follow in all actions?
questions.answer: Act in Allah’s name and by His rules.

questions.question: How should even simple things like receiving and giving be done?
questions.answer: On Allah’s behalf.

questions.question: What should guide both action and rest?
questions.answer: Allah’s permission and law.

questions.question: If someone falls short, what two things should he do?
questions.answer: Ask forgiveness and pray to Allah.

questions.question: What are the two main requests in the final prayer?
questions.answer: Forgiveness for mistakes and help to keep the trust safely.
